text: A bag contains 3 red, 5 blue and 7 yellow balls. One ball is drawn at random. Find the probability that it is (i) blue, (ii) not yellow.

At a school fair, a lucky-draw box contains 60 tickets numbered 1 to 60. A visitor draws one ticket at random.
(i) Find the probability that the number on the ticket is a multiple of 10. [1]
(ii) Find the probability that the number is a perfect square. [1]
(iii) Find the probability that the number is a two-digit prime number. [2]

A parking area has 80 vehicles: 32 two-wheelers, 28 cars, 12 autorickshaws and the rest are trucks. A vehicle is picked at random to be checked.
(i) Find the probability that it is a truck. [1]
(ii) Find the probability that it is not a car. [1]
(iii) If 20 more two-wheelers enter the parking area, find the probability that a vehicle picked at random is a two-wheeler. [2]

In a game stall, a player throws two fair dice together. The stall owner announces different prizes for different results.
(i) Find the probability that the sum of the numbers is 10. [1]
(ii) Find the probability of getting a doublet (same number on both dice). [1]
(iii) Neha wins a gift if the sum is at least 10 or the dice show a doublet. Find the probability that Neha wins. [2]
